title: The only person-only steps are the ones nothing can automate
description:
```gherkin
Feature: What a person still does

  Scenario: The list is short and written down
    Given a new deployment
    Then a person does only: apply the seed once, give the registrar the name servers, create the Google OAuth client, and put secret values such as SSM SecureString parameters
    And everything else is done by the pipeline
```
